title: Travel and playing for white audiences from Pensacola
summary: The band traveled to Mobile and played hotels for white audiences.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yeah. So you decided pretty much in Pensacola that, or?

When I was there, we were stationed there, but we did a lot of traveling. Travels, uh-huh. Yeah. We even played for some white people. There was a battle house hotel in Mobile and a hotel in Pensacola on Palafonchia, I think that was the Man Street, and a couple of other places. But I'm just showing you how that music was popular, getting popular way back up in there.
